title: fix(verify): the wave 1 catalog heal — the oauth origins join the reviewed rows
body: The Verify gate ladder broke on every landing since the wave 9 oauth doors: the sweep found two hardcoded origins oauthrow.ts names (gitlab.com and auth.devthink.pro) outside the reviewed deep link catalog, and the gate ladder exits nonzero on any open finding. The heal follows the house doctrine the reviewed catalog already carries: the documented official endpoints stay data rows of tests/artifacts/reviewedorigins.json, never code literals, and every endpoint stays user configurable. The battery goes green again on every future landing.
